darpan.migration.DarpanMigration.description: Seed a default chat space for tenants that have notification settings but no space. Idempotent — tenants that already have any chat space are skipped.
Clear chat space webhooks that can no longer be decrypted after a crypt key change. Idempotent, and a no-op on an installation that never stored a webhook.
Copy exclusion filters from the rule set into each automation's own snapshot, across every tenant. Idempotent.
Backfill the denormalized companyUserGroupId stamp on rule-set child rows created before the stamp existed. Idempotent no-op on already-stamped rows.
Translate the legacy canReadOrders flag into explicit SourceConfigEndpointAccess rows. Idempotent by PK.

Delete SourceSystemConnectorField pill rows withdrawn from seed data. Seed loads are createOrUpdate and never delete, so withdrawal needs an explicit deletion. Idempotent — a second run deletes nothing.

Fold every automation's run history into its stored clean-day streak, so the clean-run Chat line reads the day count from the first message (DAR-BE-144). Idempotent — a fold reads only slots past the stored cursor.

Move each audit statement link's list of counted causes onto its run: the causes it left out become expected (rule outcome EXPECTED) and the list is cleared; Unexplained then counts on every statement (DAR-BE-196). Idempotent; a run whose links disagree is reported and left untouched.

Give each audit its own schedule (time, zone, on/off) from the automations its checks run through (DAR-BE-199): the time most running checks share. No automation is rewritten; one off the audit's schedule is named and put on it by saving the audit's settings. Idempotent.
